visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outdoors on a gray asphalt street with a white lane marker. A young boy in a white T-shirt and white sneakers walks while holding the hand of an adult whose arm and leg are partially visible. (2) The camera pans upward to reveal street signs, power lines, and a prominent red and blue Domino's Pizza sign against a clear sky. (3) Inside a brightly lit store, a man wearing a black face mask and a grey T-shirt helps the boy put on a blue and black apron and a red baseball cap. (4) The boy stands at a dark kitchen counter, pressing a round ball of pizza dough with his palms while the man and a staff member in a blue uniform watch. (5) Close-up shot of the boy's hands spreading red tomato sauce on the flattened dough with a ladle, followed by him adding white shredded cheese and pineapple toppings. (6) The boy holds the assembled raw pizza on a screen, looking directly at the camera with a serious expression. (7) The boy carefully slides the pizza onto a metal conveyor oven belt with the help of the adult. (8) The cooked pizza emerges from the oven, and the boy uses a rolling pizza cutter to slice the pie into sections. (9) Using silver metal tongs, the boy places golden-brown chicken nuggets and sides into a cardboard pizza box. (10) The boy proudly holds the open pizza box showing the completed meal while the man kneels beside him, both looking at the camera.
